guide._how_to_edit: Reference data for the site: where to buy each kind of thing, rebates with end dates, the yearly sales calendar, big-buy watch list and store coupon rules. Sources: Better Deals project (outdoor-firearms-deals.md, master-deal-plan.md, store-directory.md) and workbook tabs (Yearly sales, Outdoor & firearms, Gear & Black Friday, Stores), Nov 2026. Calendar dates are typical patterns: confirm each year.

where_to_buy.name: Ammo
where_to_buy.tip: Search AmmoSeek first: prices vary $0.05–0.10 a round between stores ($50–100 on 1,000 rounds). Then check rebates. Store coupons usually exclude ammo, so rebates and points are the savings.

stores.name: AmmoSeek (tracker)
stores.best_for: Cheapest current price per round, by caliber

where_to_buy.name: Guns
where_to_buy.tip: Compare on Gun.deals, check the manufacturer rebate, and add shipping + the FFL transfer fee at Vance's before comparing online with in-store.

stores.name: Palmetto State Armory
stores.best_for: AR-15s, PSA pistols; biggest Black Friday sale (~58% off)

where_to_buy.name: Gun parts, magazines & reloading
where_to_buy.tip: Brownells EDGE ($49.95/yr) only pays if you build or fix guns often.

stores.name: MidwayUSA
stores.best_for: Fast shipping, reloading; optics on July 4th

where_to_buy.name: Hunting, fishing & outdoor gear
where_to_buy.tip: Bass Pro/Cabela's Spring Fishing Classic (March) and Fall Hunting Classic (Aug–Sept) have trade-ins. Join the free points programs.

stores.name: Bass Pro Shops
stores.best_for: Hunting clothes, boots, trail cams, optics

where_to_buy.name: Skincare (serums, sunscreen, brand names)
where_to_buy.tip: Drugstore basics (moisturizer, soap) are usually cheapest through CVS/Walgreens rewards: see your weekly deals. Serums and sunscreen: wait for Ulta 21 Days, The Ordinary sale or Black Friday. With tretinoin: no benzoyl peroxide or other retinoids.

stores.name: Ulta
stores.best_for: 21 Days of Beauty (Mar, Sep), BOGO 50% on Black Friday

stores.name: Woot
stores.best_for: TruSkin, Bio-Oil flash deals (compare with Keepa first)

where_to_buy.name: Supplements & protein (bulk)
where_to_buy.tip: Sam's is usually cheapest everyday (see your item cards). Stock up 6 months' worth on Black Friday and Prime Day.

stores.name: Sam's Club
stores.best_for: Everyday low: creatine, D3, fish oil, whey

where_to_buy.name: Electronics & gear
where_to_buy.tip: Set Keepa or CamelCamelCamel alerts at your target. Stack: card offer → one cash-back portal → student discount → Citi card. Don't use the Amazon account signed in as Gustavo.

stores.name: Keepa (Amazon price history)
stores.best_for: Is this Amazon price actually low?

stores.name: Woot
stores.best_for: Amazon flash deals (check new vs refurbished)

stores.name: OSU Surplus
stores.best_for: Monitors, desks, chairs; public sale 3rd Tuesday monthly

stores.name: Liquidation bin stores
stores.best_for: Liquidation Zone (3577 E Livingston, near you), Where Ya Bin (6020 Sawmill), BidFTA Bin Store (5865 Chantry): prices drop each day after restock

where_to_buy.name: Clothing, shoes & gym gear
where_to_buy.tip: Check UNiDAYS and Student Beans with your CSCC email first (Nike up to 40%, Gymshark 12%). Off-price stores are best on new-shipment days.

stores.name: UNiDAYS / Student Beans
stores.best_for: Student discounts: Nike, Adidas, Gymshark, Journeys

where_to_buy.name: Home, furniture & tools
where_to_buy.tip: Try OSU Surplus and the bin stores before buying new. Mattresses and appliances: Memorial Day, Labor Day, Black Friday.

stores.name: OSU Surplus (2650 Kenny Rd)
stores.best_for: Desks, chairs, whiteboards; 3rd Tuesday sale, cards only

stores.name: Liquidation bin stores
stores.best_for: Liquidation Zone (3577 E Livingston), Columbus Liquidation Center (4141 Refugee), CBUS Liquidators (794 Morrison)

where_to_buy.name: Car parts & tires (Mustang 235/55R17)
